output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Everyone on build 7.4.0 crashes about 2% of sessions, versus about 0.7% on 7.3.2. That was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramped. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, so the flag group is simply the 7.4.0 group. Among 7.4.0 users, flag-on is 2.10% and a random flag-off holdout is 1.98%. That difference is small and within noise. The leading crash cluster (41%) is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda 3.1) HEIF decoding. It first appeared on 2 Sep and is absent from 7.3.2. The app-store console's own crash counts show the same gap, so the crash-reporting SDK change isn't a counting artifact. Device mix, usage and the 9 Sep backend deployment don't explain it. A small flag effect, a few tenths of a point, can't be ruled out. Turning the flag off and releasing 7.4.0 to 100% would ship the real problem. Recommendation: hold 7.4.0 at 25%, fix the image-library crash, and keep the existing holdout running (widening it would speed up the measurement). Don't rework the canvas yet. I'm fairly confident in this, though less so on whether the flag has any effect.
